verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat aapaa khoi gur dhaas hoi sarab mai pooran braham kar maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: By contemplating and absorbing oneself in the name obtained by the blessings of a True Guru, and shedding the feelings of mine and his, one becomes a servant of the Guru. Such a servant acknowledges the presence of one Lord everywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗੋਰਸ ਗੋਬੰਸ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੋ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaasaT agan maalaa sootr goras goba(n)s ek aau anek ko bibek pahichaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: As the same fire exists in all the woods, different beads are arranged in the same thread; as all shades and species of cows yield milk of the same colour; similarly the slave of True Guru achieves the wisdom and knowledge of the presence of one Lord in all the living beings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੁਖ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਕ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: lochan sravan mukh naasakaa anek sotr dhekhai sunai bolai man mek ur aaneeaai ||

en.bdb: As all that is seen by the eyes, heard by the ears and said by the tongue reaches the mind, similarly the slave of the Guru sees one Lord residing in all beings and lodges Him in his mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਓੋਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੦੮॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile soha(n) soiee oot pot jotee jot milat jotee saroop jaaneeaai ||108||

en.bdb: The union of a Sikh with his Guru makes him utter Lord's name repeatedly and enjoins in Him like warp and weft. When his light merges with light eternal, he too acquires the form of light divine. (108)
